The short answer

Before installing, confirm your exact iPhone & Android model, the player’s availability in your region and the connection format your provider supports.

  1. Check your model and app store

    Check mobile data usage and country restrictions. Your player and provider must both support your phone. Confirm the exact player and any separate app fee with your provider before buying a subscription.

  2. Install from an official source

    Use the official store or the developer’s verified website for your iPhone & Android player. Read its current instructions. Do not install an unfamiliar package just because its name looks similar.

  3. Add your authorised account

    Choose the connection method supported by your player and provider. Enter the supplied server address and login or playlist URL exactly. Check for extra spaces and keep the complete details private.

  4. Load your guide and test a stream

    Allow the player to load the content supplied by your provider. Check a channel you care about, the audio language and the programme guide if your service includes one.

  5. Make the setup your own

    Save favourites and review parental controls where available. If something fails, note the device model, player version, affected stream and time before contacting support.

If it doesn’t work first time.

Check whether the issue affects one stream or the entire player. Compare another app on the same device and avoid sharing private credentials in screenshots.
